Cooking: 1 hour | difficulty = 3 | image = [[File:Burger King Chicken Nuggets (15423233415).jpg|300px]] | energy = | note = }} {{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Meat|Meat]] '''Crispy chicken''' is [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinated]] and breaded [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]]. ==Ingredients== *4 bone-in [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] thighs *⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Italian Dressing|Italian dressing]] *1½–2 cups [[cookbook:Bread Crumb|bread crumbs]] ==Procedure== #Remove the skin and fat from the chicken thighs with kitchen shears. #Place thighs in a container with Italian dressing. Seal and shake to coat. #If you have the time, allow the chicken to marinate for extra flavor. #While chicken [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinates]], put bread crumbs in a medium bowl. #Put marinated chicken thighs in the bowl one at a time, and coat them with crumbs, adding extra bread crumbs as needed. #Place breaded chicken on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]] or other [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]]. #[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] on the oven's center rack at [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|350°F]] for 45 to 55 minutes or until bread crumbs are browned. ==Notes, tips, and variations== * For easy clean-up, put [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]] between the chicken and the pan. steps.text: Remove the skin and fat from the chicken thighs with kitchen shears.
Place thighs in a container with Italian dressing. Seal and shake to coat.
If you have the time, allow the chicken to marinate for extra flavor.
While chicken marinates, put bread crumbs in a medium bowl.
Put marinated chicken thighs in the bowl one at a time, and coat them with crumbs, adding extra bread crumbs as needed.
Place breaded chicken on a cookie sheet or other baking pan.
Bake on the oven's center rack at 350°F for 45 to 55 minutes or until bread crumbs are browned.
